office_does: The prosecuting attorney prosecutes crimes in Klickitat County and is the county government's lawyer.
race_blurb: Uncontested: appointed Prosecuting Attorney Rebecca Cranston (States No Party Preference) is the only candidate for both the short and full terms.

candidates.summary: Appointed Klickitat County Prosecuting Attorney in December 2025 after nearly a decade as a deputy prosecutor; the only candidate for the short and full terms.
highlights: Appointed prosecutor by the commissioners on December 30, 2025, the only applicant [S2]
Deputy prosecutor since 2016 (civil matters and criminal appeals) [S1]
Pledges accountability for offenders and advocacy for victims [S1]
